6. Heather Locklear is an American actress best known for her role as Amanda Woodward on "Melrose Place" (1993–99).
7. Jessica Hynes is an English actress, director, and writer known for her work on the British sitcom "Spaced".
8. Nikki Kelly is an English actress best known for her role as Sylvia Garnsey in the long-running British sitcom "Hi-de-Hi!".
